prediction_unchanged: f16 > u8 >= u4 on turn-2 delta-prefill TTFT. f16 advantage 15-27 percent.
replaces: A bisection on n_cached. The prereg predicts a turn-2 ordering and a 15-27 percent f16 advantage, not a limit.
delta_integer_rule: The median of an even count is the mean of 182 and 183, which is 182.5. A prompt token length is an integer. delta_tokens is the smallest integer greater than or equal to that median.
query: For each entry, for each turn with turn >= 1, increase = n_ctx minus the n_ctx of the turn whose index is turn-1. Keep increases that are > 0. The median of those increases is delta_median_n_ctx_increase.
protocol: Per (arm, n_cached): one turn 1 fills n_cached under RESIDENT (turn-1 max_new_tokens = 1; the fill is the prompt). Then 3 turn-2 repeats. Each turn-2 is a ChatHistory whose prefix is only the post-turn-1 messages plus one new user message. The three user messages are distinct texts of identical token length delta_tokens, so a prefix-cache hit stops at n_cached. Report the per-arm median turn-2 TTFT and the f16 advantage percent versus u8 and versus u4 at each n_cached. If turn 1 fails allocation, record memory_wall and do not run turn 2.
